description: Look up a Hebrew or Greek lexicon entry. Pass strong_id (G26 or H7225) for one entry: lemma, transliteration, gloss, definition, and an occurrence count. Pass word, an English word such as love, for up to 10 entries whose gloss, definition, or King James usage matches, with an optional language of greek or hebrew. Pass word with reference (John 21:15) for the Strong's numbers used for that word in the King James text of that verse.

language.description: greek or hebrew. Limits a word lookup. Ignored when strong_id is set or when reference is set.

reference.description: One Bible verse, such as John 21:15. Together with word, returns the Strong's numbers on that word in the King James text.

strong_id.description: Strong's number, such as G26 or H7225. When this is set, word, reference, and language are ignored.

word.description: English word to match, such as love. Matched against the gloss, the Strong's definition, and King James usage.

name: lookup_lexicon
title: Look up Strong's word
